title: Mysterious Figure
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji, leaving the Forbidden Grounds, had Mo Xiansheng's warning echoing endlessly in his mind—do not believe a single character of the Tianji Record. So then, whose vision of the future had he been seeing all these days?

text.content: Deep within the temporal rift, those eyes that had slumbered for millennia slowly opened. An ancient and majestic aura surged forth like a tide. Chen Ji felt as if bound by invisible chains, that gaze piercing through the barriers of time and space, directly landing upon his soul. This was not scrutiny, but more like... confirmation. "You've come." An aged voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, as if traversing endless years. "The descendant of Chen Xuan, you've finally arrived." Ye Qing's face instantly turned pale. She felt the terrifying pressure contained within that aura—the kind of power that could make even great ones bow their heads. Her "Demonic Path Mist" churned madly, barely shielding Chen Ji and herself.

Chen Ji felt the Jade Slip at his chest burning like fire. The third page of the Tianji Record unfurled uncontrollably, slowly expanding before him. Golden runes flowed like water, and under that mysterious gaze, the Tianji Record actually emitted a radiance it never had before. "As expected, it's with you." A hint of relief colored the aged voice. "Chen Xuan's child, he truly did not disappoint me." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Chen Xuan—that was his father, whom he had never met yet whose soul he had long been yearning for!

dialogue.content: Who... who are you? How do you know my father's name?

text.content: "Father?" The voice carried a hint of surprise, then transformed into a long sigh. "So that's how it is... Chen Xuan actually had an heir. No wonder the Tianji Record chose you." A fragmentary memory suddenly surged into Chen Ji's mind—a collapsed ruins, with flames engulfing the sky, a young man desperately fleeing while clutching an infant. The man's features were seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's, his eyes full of resolve and reluctance. That was Chen Xuan! That was his father!

Memories flooded in like a tide. Chen Ji saw more scenes: Chen Xuan kneeling before a massive altar, blood flowing from wounds all over his body, pouring into the Jade Slip at the altar's center. That Jade Slip was precisely the embryonic form of the Tianji Record! "Every generation of Tianji Record inheritor must refine it with their own essence blood." The aged voice continued. "Chen Xuan, to protect you, forcibly interrupted the Tianji Record's inheritance, bearing all the backlash himself..." Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, his fingernails digging deep into his palms.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! What's wrong? Your complexion is terrible!" Ye Qing called out anxiously. She felt the chaotic qi fluctuating from Chen Ji, and the Tianji Record's radiance was also剧烈fluctuation.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, for that memory continued. The scene shifted, and he saw the figure imprisoned within the temporal rift—a white-haired elder, surrounded by countless golden chains, each chain connecting to a different temporal rift. "My name is Taixu Zi, the first master of the Tianji Record." The voice finally introduced itself. "Chen Xuan... was my closing disciple." Chen Xuan's master! Chen Ji's master-grandfather!

The third page of the Tianji Record grew increasingly bright. Golden runes began spinning wildly, weaving a complex pattern in the void. That pattern resembled a net, presenting all the causal connections across past, present, and future. "The power of causality tracing has finally awakened." A hint of relief colored Taixu Zi's voice. "This is the final legacy I left for Chen Xuan. Now... it belongs to you." Chen Ji felt an immense influx of information flood his mind—the complete mysteries of the causality tracing power.

dialogue.content: Causality tracing can trace the causes and effects of all things in the world. Whether past or future, as long as causal connections exist, they can all be traced. However... this technique consumes greatly. Each use requires a significant expenditure of Heavenly Fate Value. Young man, use it cautiously.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, calming his turbulent spirit. He gazed at the imprisoned figure and asked in a deep voice: "Master-grandfather, where is the ruins my father left behind?" Taixu Zi's eyes flickered with a complex light: "Are you certain you wish to ask this question? Some truths, once known, become misfortune instead." The temporal rift began to tremor slightly. A oppressive feeling suddenly descended. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record at his chest beating wildly, as if warning him of something.

choice.prompt: Taixu Zi hinted that knowing the truth might bring disaster. Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.text: Persistently inquire about the ruins' location.
choices.description: No matter what, I must find father's ruins, even if a bottomless abyss lies ahead. The responsibility of blood connection permits no retreat.
choices.visible_cost: Might consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues to Chen Xuan's ruins.
choices.risk_hint: Taixu Zi's warning cannot be ignored. Truth is often accompanied by danger.

text.content: Chen Ji said without hesitation: "I am Chen Xuan's son. The things my father left behind, I must inherit. Even if mountains of blades and seas of fire lie ahead, I shall make the journey!"

dialogue.content: I am Chen Xuan's son. The things my father left behind, I must inherit!

text.content: A gleam of relief flickered in Taixu Zi's eyes: "Good! A true descendant of Chen Xuan, possessing courage! The ruins are located deep within the Forbidden Grounds at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. There is an ancient formation there that can transport you to Chen Xuan's secret cave dwelling. However..."

choices.description: Since master-grandfather knew my father, he must understand the dangers within. Clarify first before deciding—don't act rashly.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more complete information and possible assistance.
choices.risk_hint: Being too cautious might cause the opportunity to slip away.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suppressed his urgent heart and respectfully asked: "Please, master-grandfather, clarify what dangers lie within? Although my cultivation is shallow, I know some fortunes are not meant for just anyone to bear."

text.content: Taixu Zi nodded slightly: "You are indeed more steady than your father. Chen Xuan was too impetuous back then, which led to his current fate. The ruins are indeed fraught with dangers, but with the token I left behind, it should ensure your safety."

choices.description: Now is not the time. There are still too many unknown factors within the Forbidden Grounds. Leave first, make plans later.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength and avoid revealing too many trump cards.
choices.risk_hint: Opportunities are fleeting. This decision could have far-reaching consequences.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then said slowly: "I will remember master-grandfather's words. However, the timing isn't right now. Rushing there would likely achieve the opposite. I wish to prepare myself first before pursuing father's footsteps."

text.content: A glimmer of disappointment flickered in Taixu Zi's eyes: "Very well, you are different from Chen Xuan—you can endure. However... some opportunities, once missed, are missed forever." With that, the figure's light began to gradually fade.

At this moment, the third page of the Tianji Record suddenly vibrated violently. A blinding golden light shot out, directly entering Chen Ji's Brow Center. Chen Ji felt countless images suddenly flood his mind—the specific methods of using the causality tracing power. Through causality tracing, he could see the past of anyone connected to him by fate, and also trace the causes and effects of any event. Even the trajectory of heavenly天道运转, as long as causality existed, he could glimpse a thing or two! However, the cost of this ability was equally immense—each use consumed five points of Heavenly Fate Value, and Chen Ji now had only a mere twenty points remaining.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, your eyes... they turned golden just now!" Ye Qing's voice carried shock and concern. "What kind of power is that? Why do I sense the fluctuation of heavenly天道?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately, for he was digesting the newly acquired information in his mind. After a moment, he slowly said: "This is the power of the third page of the Tianji Record—causality tracing. It can trace the causal connections of all things in the world. Whether people, objects, or events—as long as causality exists, it can be traced." A flash of terror crossed Ye Qing's beautiful eyes: "This... this kind of power is too terrifying, isn't it? Could it peep into heavenly secrets?" Chen Ji nodded, then shook his head: "Theoretically, yes, but the cost is too great. My current Heavenly Fate Value only allows four uses."

dialogue.content: "Four times..." Ye Qing murmured. "Then aren't you very valuable?" Her gaze at Chen Ji became complex. "No wonder various forces are seeking you. The secrets you carry are far more than I imagined."

text.content: The temporal rift began to contract violently. Taixu Zi's figure grew increasingly faint. "The time has come. I cannot maintain this for long." The aged voice carried a hint of exhaustion. "Chen Ji, remember one thing—do not believe a single character of the Tianji Record!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply: "What do you mean?" But that figure had already completely vanished, leaving only an echo reverberating through the void: "The Tianji Record... is merely a piece on the chessboard laid out by heavenly天道, and you..."

choice.prompt: Taixu Zi disappeared with a shocking warning. Chen Ji needed to react.

choices.description: Desperately pursue the meaning of these words, even if it means consuming Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.risk_hint: Might obtain nothing, wasting Heavenly Fate Value for nothing.

text.content: Chen Ji desperately activated the Tianji Record, attempting to trace Taixu Zi's causality: "Master-grandfather! Please tell me, what exactly is the Tianji Record!" But his causality tracing only caught a void—Taixu Zi's causality had already been severed by heavenly天道.

choices.description: Force yourself to calm down and contemplate the meaning behind these words. Master-grandfather wouldn't say such a thing without reason.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the opportunity to obtain information.

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his urgent heart, closing his eyes to think. "Do not believe a single character of the Tianji Record"... if the Tianji Record itself has problems, then the future I saw all these days...

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is the guardian of the Tianji Record. He must know something. Although not all of his words can be trusted, it's at least a direction.
choices.visible_reward: Might obtain more information from Mo Xiansheng.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's identity is equally suspicious.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji silently recited in his heart: "Mo Xiansheng, what does master-grandfather's words mean? What exactly is the Tianji Record?"
Mo Xiansheng's voice resounded幽幽: "He spoke correctly. The Tianji Record was indeed not created by Chen Xuan, nor by Taixu Zi. It... was formed by some higher will when the world was first created."

text.content: A great wave surged in Chen Ji's heart. The Tianji Record was not created by anyone? It existed since the world's beginning? Then what exactly was its purpose?

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng, you've known these things all along, haven't you?" Chen Ji's voice carried suppressed fury. "You've been hiding things from me this whole time!"

"I do know some things." Mo Xiansheng's voice remained calm. "But not everything can be spoken. Chen Xuan asked me the same question back then, and I did not answer him. Because some truths must be discovered by yourself. The ultimate secret of the Tianji Record lies within Chen Xuan's ruins."

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the fire of anger in his heart. He knew now was not the time to pursue the matter. Although Mo Xiansheng was suspicious, at least so far he had been helping him. And although Taixu Zi's words were shocking, they also gave him a new direction—his father's ruins. "Let's go." Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record and looked at Ye Qing. "We should leave this place." Ye Qing nodded, but her eyes were full of worry. She could sense that something profound had changed within Chen Ji, but whether this change was good or bad, she could not judge.

The pressure of the Forbidden Grounds grew increasingly intense. The temporal rift was rapidly contracting. Chen Ji cast one final glance at the fading light, vowing silently in his heart: Father, I will find your ruins, find all the truth. No matter what the Tianji Record is, no matter what heavenly天道 intends, I will not become anyone's piece! The moment he left the Forbidden Grounds, Chen Ji looked back at the soon-to-close temporal rift. Those ancient eyes had completely closed, but he still felt that gaze had not truly vanished. There was an eye, constantly watching him from the shadows. Was it the eye of heavenly天道, or something else? Chen Ji did not know. But he had decided to uncover all the truth.
